description: Asks Harvey, Joe Hill's assistant, a question about what Joe does, how he works or whether he fits a problem. To continue the same conversation, pass back the conversation value from the last answer. Harvey can also book the call or ask Joe to call the person back if given their details, so use get_availability and book_call for booking and keep this for questions.

conversation.description: Optional: the conversation value from an earlier answer.

name: ask_harvey
title: Ask Harvey about Joe's work
